mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_version (doc_id, version, title, content, editor_id, created_at) VALUES (#{docId}, #{version}, #{title}, #{content}, #{editorId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_id, version, title, content, editor_id, created_at FROM document_version WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY version DESC

SELECT dv.id, dv.version, dv.title, dv.content, dv.editor_id, u.name AS editor_name, dv.created_at FROM document_version dv LEFT JOIN user u ON dv.editor_id = u.id WHERE dv.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY dv.version DESC

SELECT dv.id, dv.version, dv.title, dv.content, dv.editor_id, u.name AS editor_name, dv.created_at FROM document_version dv LEFT JOIN user u ON dv.editor_id = u.id WHERE dv.id = #{versionId} AND dv.doc_id = #{docId}
